    Separation lemmas for the four BGRS Figure 13E statements #

    This file isolates the local algebra behind the four nonmemberships printed after BGRS Figure 13. On an arm, an endpoint-radical error can be absorbed into a unit multiple of the radical generator; a transfer of that generator would force the prohibited transit direction. In the middle, any proper factor-through Hom subbimodule below the tau^2 ray is already contained in the endpoint-radical layer, while the line through tau is separated by the strict power-span drop.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RoiterFigure13E.leftArmSupplement_separated_of_not_allowsCotransit {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Type v} [CategoryTheory.Category.{w, v} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] [∀ (T : C), Module.Finite k (CategoryTheory.End T)] [∀ (T : C), IsLocalRing (CategoryTheory.End T)] [∀ (T : C), IsArtinianRing (CategoryTheory.End T)] [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k C] {X Y : C} (alpha : X ⟶ Y) (P : ClosedZigzagTransfer.OrientedRadicalPowerParameter Y) (halphaT : AllowsTransit alpha) (halphaNotC : ¬AllowsCotransit alpha) (halphaTau : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp alpha P.tau.asHom ≠ 0) :
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp alpha P.tau.asHom ∉ leftArmSupplementObstruction alpha P.tau

    If alpha allows transit but prohibits cotransit, its first composition with the middle radical generator is separated from the full left-arm obstruction, including endpoint-radical errors.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RoiterFigure13E.rightArmSupplement_separated_of_not_allowsTransit {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Type v} [CategoryTheory.Category.{w, v} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] [∀ (T : C), Module.Finite k (CategoryTheory.End T)] [∀ (T : C), IsLocalRing (CategoryTheory.End T)] [∀ (T : C), IsArtinianRing (CategoryTheory.End T)] [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k C] {Y Z : C} (beta : Y ⟶ Z) (P : ClosedZigzagTransfer.OrientedRadicalPowerParameter Y) (hbetaC : AllowsCotransit beta) (hbetaNotT : ¬AllowsTransit beta) (htauBeta : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp P.tau.asHom beta ≠ 0) :
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp P.tau.asHom beta ∉ rightArmSupplementObstruction beta P.tau

    Source-dual arm separation: if beta allows cotransit but prohibits transit, its first precomposition by the radical generator is outside the full right-arm obstruction.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RoiterFigure13E.middleSquareSideSupplement_separated_of_not_mem_throughObject {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Type v} [CategoryTheory.Category.{w, v} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] [∀ (T : C), Module.Finite k (CategoryTheory.End T)] [∀ (T : C), IsLocalRing (CategoryTheory.End T)] [∀ (T : C), IsArtinianRing (CategoryTheory.End T)] [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k C] {X Y : C} (P : ClosedZigzagTransfer.OrientedRadicalPowerParameter Y) (htauSq : P.tau ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hnot : (P.tau ^ 2).asHom ∉ throughObjectSubmodule X Y) :
    (P.tau ^ 2).asHom ∉ middleSquareSideSupplementObstruction X Y P.tau

    A direct exclusion of tau^2 from one factor-through subbimodule implies the stronger one-sided middle supplement used by the Figure 13E coefficient compiler.
